verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud has a published pricing page on daily.co that describes agent profiles sized to compute needs, unlimited concurrency, and a Krisp noise-cancellation feature. That points to public usage-based pricing for the hosted offering. However, none of the evidence quotes an actual per-minute or per-session rate, so cost per call cannot be estimated from it. Missing for 10: explicit per-minute/usage rates, per-profile prices, a cost-per-call calculator or worked example, and independent confirmation of the pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
